$comment: The GITHUB_TOKEN permissions each workflow in .github/workflows/ is allowed to request.
The 'Workflow token permissions' group in tests/check-invariants.sh reads every workflow
and fails when a job asks for anything not written here, when a workflow or job is missing
from this file, or when an entry here names a workflow or job that no longer exists. So
widening a token's reach takes two edits a reviewer sees side by side: the workflow, and
this file. 'workflow' is the top-level permissions block; null means the file declares
none, which is the rule here: docs/security/SECURITY-AI.md has every job declare its own.
'jobs' lists every job, and each must declare exactly the block shown. Changing this file
